meta.title: AZAFCO International | Egyptian Fish Processing & Export
meta.description: AZAFCO International farms, processes, packs and exports Egyptian fish for importers, distributors and foodservice buyers. Request a quote.

hero.title: From Egyptian production to global partnerships
hero.intro: Egyptian fish, professionally processed and packed to the specification your business buys to. We work with importers, distributors and foodservice buyers from the first enquiry to the export hand-off.

trust.title: AZAFCO at a glance
trust.plant_detail: Industrial Zone, Motobas, Kafr El Sheikh, Egypt
trust.spec_detail: Species, size, presentation, packing, volume and destination
trust.direct_title: Direct line to the export team

seafood.title: Built around business buyers
seafood.p1: When you source fish, you are not buying a product listing. You need clear specifications, processing that suits your market, and one direct conversation about volume, packing and shipping.
seafood.p2: Seafood and aquaculture is AZAFCO's primary business, from production through processing and packing to export coordination. We start from your commercial requirement and work back to an offer that fits it.

products.title: Main species
products.intro: Start with tilapia, sea bass and mullet, or see the full range. Each species page sets out what to specify (size, presentation, packing), and the details are confirmed in your quote.

process.title: One supply chain, four hand-offs
process.intro: Every order moves through the same stages, each checked against the specification agreed with you.
process.s1_text: Fish comes from aquaculture production linked to AZAFCO's core business.
process.s2_text: Fish is received at the plant and sorted to the size grade you ordered.
process.s3_text: Prepared and packed to the agreed presentation, pack type and net weight.
process.s4_text: The shipment is coordinated with the documents your destination requires.

processing.title: A plant run around buyer requirements
processing.p1: Processing and packing take place at our plant in Kafr El Sheikh, with crews working in full hygiene gear.
processing.p2: Before we quote, we confirm with you what we can prepare for your market, so the offer you receive is one we can deliver.
processing.req_title: What we agree with you before quoting

quality.title: Quality you can check in the documents
quality.p1: Specifications, product data and documents sit at the centre of every supply agreement.
quality.p2: Our team shares the relevant product and facility documents once their scope and validity have been confirmed for your order.

markets.title: We start from your destination
markets.intro: Import rules, documents and transport differ from one country to the next. Tell us where the fish is going, and we check that market's requirements before confirming an offer.
markets.i1_text: The importing country and the expected point of entry.
markets.i2_text: We confirm with you which certificates and export documents the shipment needs.
markets.i3_text: Transport mode and timing are agreed with you before the quote.

group.title: Beyond seafood
group.intro: AZAFCO International also has agricultural, livestock and investment activities. Seafood remains our primary export-facing business and the focus of this website.
group.agri_text: Farmland and fruit and vegetable production.
group.invest_text: Other investment activities under the AZAFCO International name.

cta.intro: Share the species, quantity, destination and packing requirements, and our export team will start reviewing your request.
